sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-27B is compatible with OpenClaw (formerly Moltbot / Clawdbot), a self-hosted open-source AI coding agent. Connect it to Model Studio to get a full agentic coding experience in the terminal.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-27B - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: The Qwen3.6 27B native vision-language dense model builds upon the 3.5-27B version, with key improvements in agentic coding capabilities and enhanced STEM reasoning and inference skills.

sources.title: Qwen 3.6 27B lokal 2026: Qwen3, Coder & VL je Hardware-Stufe
sources.snippet: Das neue Flagship-Modell ist Qwen 3.6 27B — ein dichtes Modell unter Apache 2.0 mit 256K-Kontextfenster, das mit ~17 GB VRAM in Q4_K_M über `ollama run qwen3.6:27b` läuft.
